sentences.en: Rafael Grossi, tells me that he believes the Iranians when they say that they picked up these stockpiles, which his inspectors last saw around June 10th, and moved them
sentences.zh: 拉斐尔·格罗西告诉我，他相信伊朗人所说的，即他们在6月10日左右，也就是他的检查员最后一次看到这些库存时，就已经把它们转移了，

sentences.en: out of Isfahan before the Americans struck.
sentences.zh: 在美军袭击之前就移出了伊斯法罕。

sentences.en: So what does that tell you?
sentences.zh: 那么这说明了什么？

sentences.en: That tells you that the Iranians don't have an enrichment capability right now that might take this from near bomb grade to bomb grade.
sentences.zh: 这说明伊朗人现在没有那种可以将这些近武器级铀转化为武器级铀的浓缩能力。

sentences.en: But it does tell you that the Iranians have the fuel and if they can figure out how to fashion it into a bomb or get it further enriched, making it a lot easier to produce a bomb,
sentences.zh: 但这确实说明伊朗人拥有燃料，如果他们能弄清楚如何将其制成炸弹，或者进一步浓缩，从而更容易制造炸弹，

sentences.en: then we have a big problem all over again.
sentences.zh: 那么我们又会遇到大麻烦了。

sentences.en: Can we just take a step back here?
sentences.zh: 我们能退一步看看吗？

sentences.en: If I understand you correctly,
sentences.zh: 如果我没理解错的话，

sentences.en: it's quite possible that one of the options at the end of all of this is that we have only delayed Iran's nuclear program.
sentences.zh: 很有可能这一切结束后的选择之一，就是我们只是推迟了伊朗的核计划。

sentences.en: We haven't even destroyed it.
sentences.zh: 我们甚至还没有摧毁它。

sentences.en: If that scenario happens,
sentences.zh: 如果这种情况发生，

sentences.en: I just sort of wonder, did we actually need to get involved at all?
sentences.zh: 我只是在想，我们真的有必要参与其中吗？

sentences.en: Well, it's a really interesting question because the core of your question, Rachel, is this one.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这是一个非常有趣的问题，因为你问题的核心，雷切尔，是这一点。

sentences.en: At the end of the day, if your goal is to keep Iran from getting a nuclear weapon or even desiring a nuclear weapon, do you do it more effectively by bombing them
sentences.zh: 归根结底，如果你的目标是阻止伊朗获得核武器，甚至阻止他们渴望拥有核武器，那么通过轰炸他们，

sentences.en: or by negotiating with them?
sentences.zh: 还是通过与他们谈判，哪种方式更有效？

sentences.en: Now, I've covered this program, as we've said, for more years than I should admit.
sentences.zh: 现在，正如我们所说，我报道这个项目的时间比我应该承认的还要长。

sentences.en: And the only effective freezing of the program
sentences.zh: 而我所见过的唯一有效的冻结该计划的方法，

sentences.en: I've seen was after the Obama administration got the 2015 agreement.
sentences.zh: 是在奥巴马政府达成2015年协议之后。

sentences.en: But if President Trump and Bibi Netanyahu are right
sentences.zh: 但如果特朗普总统和内塔尼亚胡总理是对的，

sentences.en: and they have hit Iran at its weakest point,
sentences.zh: 他们确实打击了伊朗最薄弱的环节，

sentences.en: maybe this is the end of the great arc of the 1979 revolution.
sentences.zh: 这或许就是1979年革命宏大叙事的终结。

sentences.en: And maybe you will see a year from now or two years from now or three years from now the government fall and regime change to take place even though
sentences.zh: 也许一两年或三年后，你会看到该国政府倒台，政权更迭发生，尽管

sentences.en: American officials say that's not their goal.
sentences.zh: 美国官员称这并非他们的目标。

sentences.en: And if that's the case, you may have a more compliant Iran.
sentences.zh: 如果是这样，你可能会迎来一个更顺从的伊朗。

sentences.en: But there's another alternative.
sentences.zh: 但还有另一种可能。

sentences.en: And that alternative is that the lesson that the Iranians draw from this is that the Americans can't be trusted,
sentences.zh: 另一种可能是，伊朗人从中吸取的教训是美国人不可信，

sentences.en: that Israel was conducting a war that clearly went beyond just going after their nuclear program and the only way the regime can survive and the only way the country can survive
sentences.zh: 以色列发动的战争显然不仅仅是为了针对他们的核计划，而政权生存、国家生存的唯一途径

sentences.en: is by racing for a nuclear weapon.
sentences.zh: 就是竞相制造核武器。

sentences.en: That maybe the North Koreans were on to something by not waiting
sentences.zh: 也许朝鲜人当初不等待是对的，

sentences.en: and that what they need to do is take the program underground, throw out the inspectors, get rid of the non-proliferation treaty requirements and do their best to take what's left
sentences.zh: 他们需要做的是将计划转入地下，驱逐核查人员，摆脱《不扩散核武器条约》的限制，并尽其所能利用剩余的一切

sentences.en: and rebuild it into a bomb project.
sentences.zh: 将其重建为一个核弹项目。

sentences.en: David, thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 大卫，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you, Rachel.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，雷切尔。

sentences.en: We're in for quite a ride.
sentences.zh: 我们即将迎来一段动荡的时期。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: On Friday,
sentences.zh: 周五，

sentences.en: Mahmoud Khalil, the 30-year-old former Columbia student who became the face of the Trump administration's crackdown on pro-Palestinian demonstrators, returned home to New York
sentences.zh: 30岁的前哥伦比亚大学学生马哈茂德·哈利勒回到了纽约家中，他曾因特朗普政府对亲巴勒斯坦示威者的镇压而成为焦点人物，

sentences.en: after three months in detention.
sentences.zh: 此前他被拘留了三个月。

sentences.en: Mr. Khalil, a Palestinian born in a Syrian refugee camp, vowed to immediately continue advocating for the people of Gaza.
sentences.zh: 哈利勒先生是一位出生在叙利亚难民营的巴勒斯坦人，他誓言将立即继续为加沙人民奔走呼吁。

sentences.en: And a suicide bomber attacked a Greek Orthodox church service in Syria's capital on Sunday, killing at least
sentences.zh: 周日，一名自杀式炸弹袭击者袭击了叙利亚首都的一场希腊正教会礼拜活动，造成至少

sentences.en: 20 people and underscoring the new government's challenge to maintaining stability and preventing sectarian violence.
sentences.zh: 20人死亡，这也凸显了新政府在维持稳定和防止教派暴力方面所面临的挑战。

sentences.en: The attacker appeared to have had ties to the Islamic State, the extremist group that once controlled large areas of Syria, the authorities said.
sentences.zh: 当局表示，袭击者似乎与伊斯兰国有关联，该极端组织曾一度控制了叙利亚大片地区。

sentences.en: It was the first known suicide bombing in the capital since December when a rebel coalition ousted Syria's president,
sentences.zh: 这是自去年12月反政府武装联盟推翻叙利亚总统

sentences.en: Bashar al-Assad, and took power.
sentences.zh: 巴沙尔·阿萨德并夺取政权以来，首都发生的首起已知自杀式炸弹袭击事件。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine until this summer
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一台严密控制的机器一样运作，直到今年夏天

sentences.en: when elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 选举迎来了一批自称改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那时起，该党就陷入了一场激烈、混乱，有时又令人兴奋的斗争之中。

sentences.zh: 莎拉·凯尼格，讲述了人们试图维持影响力却在过程中逐渐失控的故事。
